steps.title: Cream the fats and sugars
steps.body: Cream together **½ cup shortening**, **½ cup butter**, **1 cup sugar** and **1 cup brown sugar**.

steps.title: Add the salt and leaveners
steps.body: Add **½ tsp salt**, **1 tsp baking soda** and **½ tsp baking powder**.

steps.title: Mix in oats and flour
steps.body: Mix in **2 cups regular oats** and **2 cups flour**.

steps.title: Add the mix-ins
steps.body: Add **¾ cup coconut**, **¾ cup chopped nuts** and **1 cup chocolate chips**, or mix with butterscotch chips if desired.

steps.title: Drop and bake
steps.body: Drop onto cookie sheets, and bake at 350°F for 10–13 minutes.
